SELECT tier, is_current, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from), MAX(valid_from), MIN(valid_to), MAX(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_ids,
 SUM(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_rows,
 SUM(CASE WHEN is_current AND valid_to<>'9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_but_closed,
 SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_current AND valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noncur_but_open
FROM dim_member
